blocker: TGFM ships no pre-fit gene-tissue models (Zenodo record contains only a 128 kB code zip). Step 1 (susie_eqtl_fine_mapping_for_tgfm.py) needs either individual-level eQTL genotypes + expression, or full eQTL summary statistics PLUS in-sample eQTL genotypes; for GTEx brain tissues both require dbGaP phs000424 controlled access (registration/approval not allowed here). Step 2 requires GWAS in-sample LD (the published analysis used UK Biobank genotypes; Davies 2018 has no in-sample LD, only 1000G EUR n=503), and Step 4 learns tissue priors genome-wide across all loci.
notes: Not substituted with any weaker method.

weights_source: would be PredictDB GTEx v7 brain elastic-net (GRCh37 rsIDs) or GTEx v8 mashr (GRCh38)
blocker: Scope/time blocker, not an access blocker: cTWAS separates mediated from non-mediated (SNP) effects only after genome-wide estimation of gene and SNP prior inclusion probabilities and effect variances over all ~1,700 LD blocks, which needs genome-wide region/SNP maps and LD for every block plus multi-tissue weights; this did not fit the ~90 min / 3-thread budget alongside the running MAGMA job. A locus-only run with fixed priors would not be cTWAS as published.
notes: Recommended next method: it is the one maintained tool that explicitly models non-mediated SNP effects rather than folding them into a NULL model.
